visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with her brown hair neatly tied back, wearing a white Fila brand t-shirt, stands inside a brightly illuminated retail store environment. She holds a rectangular yellow box labeled ROIHI-TSUBOKO very close to the camera lens, showcasing the product details. Her facial expression is highly animated with a wide smile and bright eyes as she speaks directly to the viewer. The background consists of blurred store shelves filled with various merchandise and warm indoor lighting. (2) The woman continues her presentation, switching between showing the yellow medicinal patch box and a smaller blue version of the same brand. She uses frequent hand gestures, pointing at the boxes to emphasize her points while her expression remains energetic and surprised. Graphic overlays and Chinese text subtitles appear dynamically on the screen to highlight her speech. The camera maintains a stable medium close-up framing throughout this segment. (3) The visual perspective shifts to a direct close-up and panning shot of a stationery display rack. The shelves are densely packed with colorful rolls of washi tape, decorative stickers, and small packaged tools. The prominent logo for NICHIBAN is visible on several signs and product labels. The lighting is bright and even, clearly revealing the textures and vibrant colors of the paper products and tapes.
